parsed.internal_thinking: I am currently at 4 victory points and need only one more settlement to win. To build a settlement on node 23, where I already have a road, I need 1 wood, 1 brick, 1 wheat, and 1 sheep. I currently have 3 wood and 2 wheat. My previous attempt to trade for brick from Ziv failed because he didn't have any. I know Shon has sheep (2) and Ziv has sheep (1). Although both players are wary of my lead, Ziv has a wood port but no wood production, making him a logical trade partner for my excess wood. I will offer him 2 wood for 1 sheep, framing it as a way for him to utilize his port and for us to both counter Shon's wheat dominance. The dice rolled a 7, but since no 'move_robber' action is available in the allowed actions, I will proceed with trading. If I get the sheep, I'll only need a brick (which I produce on a roll of 6) to win.
parsed.note_to_self: I need 1 brick and 1 sheep to win. Ziv has a wood port and 1 sheep in hand. Shon is hostile and blocking me, so Ziv is the only viable trade partner. I produce brick on 6 and sheep on 4, 5, and 8.
parsed.say_outloud: זיו, שמע, שון סתם מנסה להפחיד אותך. אני רחוקה מהניצחון כי אין לי טיט בכלל, ואתה יודע שזה נדיר עכשיו. אני מוכנה לתת לך שני עץ בשביל כבשה אחת. זה ייתן לך המון כוח עם נמל העץ שלך ולי זה בסך הכל ייתן אפשרות לזוז קצת. שון הוא האיום האמיתי כאן עם כל ה-חיטה שלו, הוא כבר בנה עיר ואנחנו חייבים להתקדם כדי לא להישאר מאחור.
